title: Four ordered MLINE LTYPE XDATA entity references

scope.source: Runtime-generated DXF records; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

proof.source: The generated physical LTYPE XDATA, typed imported values, four distinct source handles, captured entity roles, model-space owner bindings and exact entity identities agree. All LINE targets are uniquely identified by handle and start-X value.
proof.output: Across all four ASCII/binary source-output pairs, staged physical output preserves XDATA order and emits each soft pointer as the exact remapped handle for its corresponding model-space LINE. Fresh typed readback verifies ordered values and entity identity/owner joins.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the fourth target refuses output atomically and preserves a destination sentinel; restoring it by saved list position succeeds on the same adapter. Late mutation of the fourth target handle also refuses atomically; restoring the source handle succeeds on the same adapter.

limits: This qualifies one four-reference AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA composition with one APPID, one string and four handles to model-space LINEs. Five-or-more references, other target types/sections, XDATA compositions, APPID metadata, schemas and versions remain unqualified.
This is transport/identity evidence only. It does not establish application-specific XDATA meaning, native MLINE rendering, recursive document closure or broader LTYPE support.
next: Select a source-backed current MLINE geometry/schema witness. Treat five-or-more LTYPE XDATA references and other target roles as separate unqualified boundaries.
